usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/olostep/v1/crawls with JSON body {start_url, max_pages} (x402 USDC on Base, $0.01). Then poll GET https://x402.orth.sh/olostep/v1/crawls/{id} (FREE) until status=="completed".
usage.outputShape: POST returns body.id (crawl id) and body.status="in_progress". Poll GET on the id returns body.status ("in_progress"->"completed"), body.pages_count, body.credits_consumed.
quirks: Async/queued: the paid POST returns status='in_progress' with a crawl id (body.id like 'crawl_xxx'), NOT the crawl results.
Poll GET https://x402.orth.sh/olostep/v1/crawls/{id} to get progress; this status GET is FREE (no x402 payment) and returns 200.
Crawl completes fast for small max_pages (1 page completed within seconds in testing).
Required body fields: start_url and max_pages. Optional: include_urls/exclude_urls (glob), max_depth, search_query, webhook_url, timeout.
Price is fixed at $0.01 per crawl-create call (accepts.amount=10000 USDC base units) despite priceDisplay='Varies'; per-page credits tracked in credits_consumed.
Supply a webhook_url in the POST body to get pushed the final result instead of polling.
usage.guide: Start a crawl with POST https://x402.orth.sh/olostep/v1/crawls and JSON body {"start_url":"<url>","max_pages":<n>} — this is the only paid step (x402 USDC on Base, ~$0.01). The response is a queued job: read body.id and note status='in_progress'. Then poll GET https://x402.orth.sh/olostep/v1/crawls/{id} (free, no payment) every few seconds until body.status=='completed'; read body.pages_count and body.credits_consumed. Alternatively pass webhook_url in the POST body to be notified on completion instead of polling.
